item.text: {"search_note":"I found no 2024 source showing Tinubu initiating, expanding, or justifying a war of choice, cross-border coercion, annexation, covert destabilization, or proxy conflict. The available record is therefore best read as absence of evidence for 2B.2 violations, not affirmative proof of perfect restraint. Where force did appear in 2024, it was tied to domestic security and protest management, not external aggression.","evidence":[{"title":"President Tinubu Calls for Suspension of Sanctions on Guinea, Mali, Niger, Burkina Faso","publisher":"State House, Nigeria","date":"February 24, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-calls-for-suspension-of-sanctions-on-guinea-mali-niger-burkina-faso/","summary":"Tinubu said sanctions had become ineffective and urged “a better path” through negotiation and improved governance. This is the clearest evidence against cross-border coercion or war of choice in the ECOWAS arena.","question_ids":["2B.2","2B.1","1B.4","1B.1","1B.2"]},{"title":"Tinubu seeks dialogue with protesters, asks them to suspend demonstrations","publisher":"TheCable","date":"August 4, 2024","url":"https://www.thecable.ng/breaking-tinubu-asks-protesters-to-suspend-demonstrations-seeks-dialogue/","summary":"Tinubu asked protesters to suspend demonstrations to “create room for dialogue.” This is not an external-conflict item, but it shows a consistent preference for negotiation over escalation when a peaceful channel exists.","question_ids":["2B.2","2B.1","1B.8"]},{"title":"Nigeria security forces deploy, government offers dialogue as protests loom","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"July 31, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economic-indicators/nigeria-security-forces-deploy-government-offers-dialogue-as-protests-loom-3546462","summary":"Reuters reported that the government said it was open to dialogue before the protests, even as security forces deployed in major cities. This is mixed evidence on crisis management, but it does not indicate any offensive war, annexation, or proxy operation.","question_ids":["2B.2","2B.1","1B.8"]}]}
